notes.subject: Long Drive: click to swing, arrow-key clubs, meter and panel by the ball, fanfare, sounds
notes.body:
- Mouse click on the view counts as a swing press (menus excluded); Up/Down picks the club (Up = longer)
- Arc meter and info panel sit either side of the ball at address; panel moves to the corner in flight
- Landing: bigger dust burst, bounce puffs, camera bump. Target: confetti, ring pulse, shake.

notes.subject: Long Drive: arc swing meter, targets and scoring, 12-club bag, wider fairway

- 12 clubs set by distance (Ryan's chart); launch speed solved from distance (speedFor), tunable per club
- 6 targets with rings; points = yards x ring bonus (miss x1 ... bullseye x3); 10-ball bucket; end screen
- Fairway 90 yds wide and runs behind the tee; higher camera; fewer yard markers
- Tests: every club within 3 yards of its chart distance, scoring, bucket

flies each letter through the middle to its new petal. Power-ups describe
themselves on hover. Kit: settingsScreen and PauseMenu take devTools: false
to leave the Dev tools switch out of Settings.

notes.subject: Word Gardens chunk 3: themed daily crosswords, stamp card, mystery prize
notes.body:
Crossword layout generator (clean crossings, size limit) and two years of
themed dailies from config/themes.txt. Crossing words share cells, and a word
whose letters all show fills by itself. Stamp card pays a prize per daily and a
card prize on the seventh stamp. Daily mystery prize: three boxes drawn by date,
shuffle, pick one, see the others. Save upgraded to version 3.

(pick a letter, shown everywhere), seeds and fertilizer hidden in board cells
and collected when their word fills, bonus jar with a weighted prize table,
results rewards with the Double Up toggle. Save upgraded to version 2 with a
